steps.npc: Patients, patients everywhere! We need to get these soldiers up and fighting again!
I don't have time to chat, I have patients to attend to.
I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in!

historical-dialogue.npc: Patients, patients everywhere! We need all the help we can get to get these soldiers up and fighting again. Can you help us?

options.text: Sure, what do you need me to do?

steps.player: Sure, what do you need me to do?

steps.text: If the player does not have Shayzien medpacks in their inventory:

steps.npc: Firstly, you're going to need to gather some medpacks. There should be plenty of boxes around here with some in.
After you've got some, we have several tents full of soldiers who've been hurt in the battle against the lizardmen.

steps.text: If the player has Shayzien medpacks in their inventory:

steps.npc: Good, you have already found some medpacks. Now, we have several tents full of soldiers who've been hurt in the battle against the lizardmen.
If you could help them out with those medpacks, that would be a massive help.
The people of Shayzien will thank you.

steps.player: Thank you, I will get right to it.

options.text: No, I'm sorry but I've got better things to be doing.

steps.player: No, I'm sorry but I've got better things to be doing.
